name: Oberursel (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Oberursel (Taunus) (a white pale with a wheel on blue and crest).
history: Municipal flag of Oberursel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Oberursel arms — pale with wheel on blue
